sentences.text: F o r R e s p o n d e n t ( s ) : M r . V . S . G o d a r a , P P

_________________________________ HON'BLE MR.
JUSTICE DEEPAK MAHESHWARI Order 22/02/2018 Heard learned counsel for the accused-petitioner.

After making submission for some time, learned counsel for the petitioner prays to issue direction to the petitioner to record his presence before the trial court with liberty to move an application seeking bail.

Looking to the fact that the criminal case for the offence under Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act is pending against the petitioner since the year 1991, the prayer made by counsel for the petitioner is allowed.

In view of the facts stated above, the misc. petition is allowed with the direction to the accused-petitioner to surrender before the trial court on or before 12.03.2018 and to move the bail application before the court, the same will be decided by the trial court on the same date and bailbonds submitted by him shall be attested to its satisfaction.
(DEEPAK MAHESHWARI)J. Rm/74 Vimal Kumar Dhawan vs State Of Rajasthan Through Pp on 22 February, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/192126740/
